Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_NeedTailoringLeve: Players need a sufficient tailoring level to read size labels and to resize clothes
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_TailoringXpMultip: How much tailoring exp checking, resizing and reconditioning clothes gives
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_ActionTimeMultipl: How long check, resize and recondition actions take
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_RipChanceMultipli: How likely tight clothes rip when climbing a wall, a fence or a window
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_DropChanceMultipl: How likely loose pants and skirts fall off when worn without a belt while both hands are busy
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_InsulationReduceM: How much insulation loose clothes lose, up to 50%%
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_CombatSpeedReduce: How much loose tops slow down combat
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_IncreaseTripChanc: Extra chance to fall when vaulting fences in loose pants and skirts
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_IncreaseStiffness: Tight clothes add stiffness during exercise and running, and slow down stiffness recovery
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_EnableClothesDegr: Most worn clothes (not shoes) slowly lose condition. The rate depends on protection, resistance, dirt, blood, wetness and fit; tight clothes wear faster. Maintenance and tailoring slow it down
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_MinDaysToDegrade_: Minimum days for clothes to fully degrade (worst conditions)
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_MaxDaysToDegrade_: Maximum days for clothes to fully degrade (best conditions)
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_ChanceToDegradeOn: Chance that clothes lose condition when resizing or reconditioning fails
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_ProtectionLossEac: Percentage of base protection (scratch, bite, bullet) lost for each condition point lost
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_ResistanceLossEac: Percentage of base resistance (wind, water) lost for each condition point lost
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_ListCustomClothes: Clothing items that should have sizes, with an optional difficulty (1, 2 or 3), separated by commas. <LINE> Example: Base.Clothing0,Base.Clothing1:1,Base.Clothing2:3
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_EnableShoeSizes_t: Shoes get an EU size (35-47). Each character has a fixed foot size depending on sex. 3 sizes too small: can't be worn. Too small: discomfort, blisters (more when running) and foot stiffness. 2+ sizes too big: more endurance used when running, rare blisters, trip chance when vaulting fences, weaker stomps on downed zombies; 3+ sizes too big: discomfort; a shoe 2+ sizes too big can come off when vaulting, climbing or falling, and 3+ sizes too big also when running (more likely without laces). Improvised foot wraps have no size
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_ShowPlayerSize_to: Shows your clothing size (and shoe size) on the character Info tab, next to your weight. Always hidden when a mod hides your weight (Immersive Weighing), since your size follows your weight.
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_ShoeEffectMultipl: Scales blisters, extra endurance use and shoe loss chance of badly fitting shoes. 0 disables these effects and the discomfort
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_ExtraSizedLocatio: Body locations (from any mod) whose clothes get a size even when the item declares no covered body parts, with an optional difficulty (1, 2 or 3), separated by commas or semicolons. <LINE> Clothes from mods are otherwise sized automatically from what they cover. Example: gorget;kiuc:2
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_ListExcludedCloth: Clothing items that must never have a size (full type), separated by commas. <LINE> Example: Base.Apron_Black,SomeMod.Cape
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_PatternMaxUses_to: How many times a traced pattern can be used (success or failure) before it falls apart.
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_ShoePatternLevel_: Tailoring level to sew shoes from a pattern. Tracing needs one level less. Ignored when the tailoring level requirement is off.
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_RequireThimble_to: Sewing by hand (patterns, resizing, reconditioning) needs a thimble in the inventory. It is not used up. Sewing machines don't need one.
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_MachineBonusMulti: Scales every sewing machine bonus (speed, Tailoring levels, size precision, thread saved). 0 = a machine gives no bonus, 2 = twice the bonus.
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_MachineNoiseMulti: Scales the range of the noise that attracts zombies while a machine runs. 0 = silent machines.
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_EnableMachineMain: Machines wear out, can break needles and jam, and need a screwdriver and cooking oil to be serviced.
Sandbox_MyTailorIsRich_SewingLootMultipl: Scales how often sewing machines and store-bought patterns appear in loot. 0 = never.
